entities.name: Query Ppnp protein
observations: 107-residue protein sequence contains two ambiguous X residues.
Pfam Ppnp domain PF06865.18 spans residues 14–105 with i-Evalue 7.2e-33.
Matches reviewed pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylases at 48.5–54.0% identity and 93.5–94.4% query coverage.
Homolog annotations assign EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2; exact substrate preference is not experimentally established for this query sequence.

entities.name: Pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase
observations: Reviewed homologs catalyze reversible phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides to free nucleobases and alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Reported substrates include uridine, adenosine, guanosine, cytidine, thymidine, inosine, and xanthosine.
Associated EC numbers are EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: General reaction: purine or pyrimidine D-ribonucleoside + phosphate ⇌ free nucleobase + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Examples include guanosine + phosphate ⇌ guanine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate and adenosine + phosphate ⇌ adenine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Reaction direction is reversible; Rhea mappings include RHEA:13233, RHEA:19805, RHEA:27642, RHEA:52540, and related entries.
